name: What are the benefits of choosing a metal roof for my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing a metal roof for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a metal roof offers several benefits, including exceptional durability, resistance to fire, rot, and insects, and a long lifespan of 40-70 years. Metal roofs can also be energy-efficient by reflecting solar radiant heat, potentially lowering cooling costs. Their interlocking panels and robust construction provide superior protection against high winds, a significant advantage in areas prone to severe weather.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs offer durability, fire resistance, a long lifespan, and energy efficiency. They also provide superior protection against high winds.
